title: The Wager
author: David Grann
summary: David Grann tells how the British warship HMS Wager was wrecked off Patagonia in 1741, and how the survivors split into rival groups. He follows the conflicting accounts when some of them made it home.
readIf: you like survival stories that are well researched and told with suspense.
skipIf: you are squeamish about starvation, violence and cannibalism.
